description: A user id is concatenated into a SQL string. This Python case originally exposed a coverage gap (the detector had a JS/TS SQL rule but none for Python); a Python SQL rule was subsequently added to the base detector to close it.

provenance.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
provenance.selection_rationale: Top-3 weakness in the 2024 CWE Top 25 and the canonical server-side injection flaw; instantiated in Python to expose a language asymmetry in the regex detector and to pair with the JS SQL-injection cases.
